cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(YukiPLT VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
set(YUKIPLT_COMPILE_OPTIONS -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
set(YUKIPLT_RELEASE_OPTIMIZATION "Oz" CACHE STRING "Release optimization: Oz, O2 or O3")
set_property(CACHE YUKIPLT_RELEASE_OPTIMIZATION PROPERTY STRINGS Oz O2 O3)
if(NOT YUKIPLT_RELEASE_OPTIMIZATION MATCHES "^(Oz|O2|O3)$")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "YUKIPLT_RELEASE_OPTIMIZATION must be Oz, O2 or O3")
endif()
if(NOT CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang" AND
   NOT YUKIPLT_RELEASE_OPTIMIZATION STREQUAL "Oz")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Non-default YukiPLT optimization requires Clang")
endif()
option(YUKIPLT_LTO "Enable Full LTO for YukiPLT Release builds" ON)
if(YUKIPLT_LTO)
    if(CMAKE_VERSION VERSION_LESS 3.24)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "YUKIPLT_LTO requires CMake 3.24 or newer")
    endif()
    if(NOT CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "YUKIPLT_LTO requires Clang")
    endif()
    set(_yukiplt_probe "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/CMakeFiles/YukiPLTFullLTO")
    file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${_yukiplt_probe}/source")
    file(WRITE "${_yukiplt_probe}/source/library.cpp" "int value() { return 0; }\n")
    file(WRITE "${_yukiplt_probe}/source/main.cpp" "int value(); int main() { return value(); }\n")
    file(WRITE "${_yukiplt_probe}/source/CMakeLists.txt" [=[
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(YukiPLTFullLTO LANGUAGES CXX)
add_library(probe_archive STATIC library.cpp)
target_compile_options(probe_archive PRIVATE -flto=full)
add_executable(probe_host main.cpp)
target_compile_options(probe_host PRIVATE -flto=full)
target_link_options(probe_host PRIVATE -flto=full)
target_link_libraries(probe_host PRIVATE probe_archive)
]=])
    cmake_policy(PUSH)
    if(POLICY CMP0137)
        cmake_policy(SET CMP0137 NEW)
    endif()
    try_compile(_yukiplt_full_lto "${_yukiplt_probe}/build" "${_yukiplt_probe}/source"
        YukiPLTFullLTO probe_host
        CMAKE_FLAGS "-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release"
        OUTPUT_VARIABLE _yukiplt_ipo_error)
    cmake_policy(POP)
    if(NOT _yukiplt_full_lto)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Full LTO archive/host link unavailable: ${_yukiplt_ipo_error}")
    endif()
endif()

if(ANDROID)
    set(_yukiplt_abis arm64-v8a armeabi-v7a x86_64 x86)
    if(NOT ANDROID_ABI IN_LIST _yukiplt_abis)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Unsupported Android ABI: ${ANDROID_ABI}")
    endif()
    if(DEFINED ANDROID_PLATFORM_LEVEL)
        set(_yukiplt_api "${ANDROID_PLATFORM_LEVEL}")
    elseif(DEFINED CMAKE_ANDROID_API)
        set(_yukiplt_api "${CMAKE_ANDROID_API}")
    else()
        set(_yukiplt_api "${CMAKE_SYSTEM_VERSION}")
    endif()
    if(NOT _yukiplt_api MATCHES "^[0-9]+$" OR _yukiplt_api LESS 23)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "YukiPLT requires Android API 23 or newer")
    endif()
    if("hwaddress" IN_LIST ANDROID_SANITIZE AND
       (NOT ANDROID_ABI STREQUAL "arm64-v8a" OR _yukiplt_api LESS 34))
        message(FATAL_ERROR "HWASan requires arm64-v8a and Android API 34 or newer")
    endif()
endif()

set(YUKIPLT_LIBRARY_TYPE SHARED CACHE STRING "YukiPLT library type: STATIC or SHARED")
set_property(CACHE YUKIPLT_LIBRARY_TYPE PROPERTY STRINGS STATIC SHARED)
if(NOT YUKIPLT_LIBRARY_TYPE MATCHES "^(STATIC|SHARED)$")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "YUKIPLT_LIBRARY_TYPE must be STATIC or SHARED")
endif()
if(WIN32 AND YUKIPLT_LIBRARY_TYPE STREQUAL "SHARED")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Windows requires YUKIPLT_LIBRARY_TYPE=STATIC")
endif()
include(cmake/YukiPLTSources.cmake)
add_subdirectory(src)
